name: Exp_DSSBressert
summary: This EA trades based on the DSS Bressert double smoothed stochastic indicator, opening buy positions when the smoothed stochastic crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward. It uses a crossover of two indicator buffer lines (UpValue/DnValue) on a configurable timeframe to generate entry and exit signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于DSS Bressert双平滑随机指标进行交易，当平滑随机指标向上交叉时开多仓，向下交叉时开空仓。它在可配置的时间周期上使用两个指标缓冲区线的交叉来生成入场和出场信号，并设有固定的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于DSS Bressert双平滑随机指标的交叉信号。入场条件为：当UpValue线从下方穿越DnValue线时产生买入信号，当DnValue线从下方穿越UpValue线时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括：持有多头时DnValue上穿UpValue触发平多仓，持有空头时UpValue上穿DnValue触发平空仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA仅在新增K线时检测信号，避免重复交易，并使用SignalBar参数允许在第0根或第1根K线获取信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the DSS Bressert double smoothed stochastic indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the UpValue line crosses above the DnValue line, and a sell signal is generated when the DnValue line crosses above the UpValue line. Exit conditions include closing long positions when DnValue crosses above UpValue, and closing short positions when UpValue crosses above DnValue, along with fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a proportion of the deposit. Money management features a 1:2 risk-reward ratio with 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit. The EA only checks for signals on new bars to avoid redundant trades, and uses the SignalBar parameter to allow signal retrieval from either bar 0 or bar 1.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit share (positive) or fixed lot size (negative)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用双平滑随机指标减少虚假信号，信号质量优于普通随机指标
风险回报比为1:2，有利于长期盈利期望
提供买卖方向开关，灵活控制交易方向
新K线检测机制避免同一信号重复交易
pros_en: Double smoothed stochastic reduces false signals compared to standard stochastic, improving signal quality
1:2 risk-reward ratio supports positive long-term expectancy
Buy/sell direction toggles provide flexible directional control
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same signal
cons: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动性变化，在高波动期可能过于紧密
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能不利入场
指标缓冲区数据复制失败时仅设置Recount标志，无重试限制和错误日志
缺少对已有持仓的检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially too tight during high volatility
No spread filter, may enter at unfavorable conditions when spread is wide
On indicator buffer copy failure, only sets Recount flag with no retry limit or detailed error logging
No check for existing positions, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整
增加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，防止不利条件下入场和重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for adaptive adjustment to market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum position check to prevent entries under unfavorable conditions and duplicate positions

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损
未检查已有持仓方向，可能同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
指标数据复制失败后无保护机制，可能在数据异常时产生错误信号
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
No existing position direction check may lead to duplicate positions increasing risk exposure
No protection mechanism after indicator data copy failure, may generate erroneous signals on data anomalies

It uses a crossover of two indicator buffer lines (UpValue/DnValue) on a configurable timeframe to generate entry and exit signals, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
